questions.q: According to Section 24 of RA 10915, which government agencies and programs are mandated to employ agricultural and biosystems engineers, and for what specific purposes should they create various levels of engineer positions?
choices: Only the Department of Agriculture and selected related agencies are mandated to employ agricultural and biosystems engineers primarily for projects involving crop production, pest management, and irrigation systems, focusing mainly on technical support for agriculture and mechanization programs in rural areas.

All concerned national government agencies, LGUs, and SUCs involved in research, development, training, extension, testing, evaluation, inspection, and environmental programs related to agriculture and biosystems. They should create various levels of engineer positions for these purposes.

Only the LGUs and private sectors are required to employ agricultural and biosystems engineers, specifically to implement and manage farm mechanization, post-harvest facilities, and agro-processing programs, with emphasis on operational efficiency, local development, and public-private partnerships in agricultural infrastructure.

All government agencies are expected to involve agricultural and biosystems engineers mainly for regulatory, inspection, and compliance activities related to environmental protection and conservation. However, this does not necessarily mandate the creation of new engineering positions but encourages collaboration with existing personnel.
